summary: First-finish smoke testing for Copilot License Governance Portal. Backend auth + 6 critical endpoints verified via curl. Frontend smoke tested end-to-end with Playwright across login, employee/manager dashboards, RBAC, approvals, licenses, audit, reclamation, and notifications.
passed: POST /api/auth/login: admin & manager return 200 with JWT token + user payload
POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401 'Invalid email or password'
GET /api/auth/me returns logged-in manager profile (cookie-based)
GET /api/requests?status=pending returns Hiro's pending request
GET /api/licenses?status=assigned returns assigned-license rows
GET /api/reclamation/candidates lists Esha (reclaim candidate)
GET /api/audit returns audit rows with request.created events
GET /api/meta/reference returns managers list
GET /api/analytics/overview is the correct path (server has /overview, /by-project, /by-cost-center, /requests-trend)
POST /api/requests for Hiro returns 400 'You already have an active license or pending request' (duplicate guard works)
Login page: wrong-password shows data-testid=login-error pill
Admin login redirects to /dashboard and renders charts (recharts SVGs visible)
Employee Alice login: employee-dashboard renders with Manage/renewal link
RBAC: Employee Alice redirected to /dashboard from /approvals, /licenses, /audit, /reclamation
Manager Marcus dashboard loads with 23 SVG chart elements; analytics charts render
Approvals page Pending tab shows 2 review buttons; Review modal opens with Approve & Reject buttons (testids approve-btn-*, reject-btn-*)
Licenses page: licenses-search filter works (rows render for 'alice')
Audit page: audit-search input works
Reclamation page: bulk-notify-btn renders; reclaim candidates listed
Notifications bell present in layout

failed.issue: On Hiro's dashboard text search for 'pending' (case-insensitive) returned False. Hiro is supposed to see a 'Pending' status card per requirements. May be using different wording (e.g., 'Awaiting approval'). Worth a visual confirm by main agent.
On Alice's dashboard text search for 'assigned' was False (manage/renewal link was True). Pill may render as 'Active' instead of 'Assigned'. Cosmetic, not functional.

action_items: Optional: main agent visually confirm that Hiro's employee dashboard explicitly displays a 'Pending' pill/card and Alice's shows 'Assigned' pill (test could not match the exact text, but the cards render and Manage/renewal links are visible).
No backend blockers. No critical UI blockers. App is ready for full testing.
notes: Did not exercise: end-to-end approve→assign with audit verification, renewal continue/release, moved-project transfer, bulk-notify submit, notifications dropdown after approval, new-request happy path for Ivy. These were skipped due to latency budget; core data paths and RBAC are verified. Logout via dropdown sequence: requires closing any open dialog first (user-menu-btn is then clickable; data-testid=logout-btn is inside the dropdown menu).
